items.label: 孟什维克
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign the flat stacked Russian party abbreviation of this complete gold adviser icon as a BEAUTIFULLY COMPOSED ARTISTIC CYRILLIC MONOGRAM, not ordinary typed text. Exact five letters: Р С Д Р П (РСДРП). Preserve the abbreviation but turn it into a single compact interwoven typographic emblem. Draw tall strong Р and sweeping С as the upper silhouette, nested Д Р П tightly into the lower half. Interlock the letters across the two levels with selected shared stems, a firm architectural baseline and restrained elongated slab-serifs; adjust scale and rhythm rather than regular typesetting. Inspired by early-twentieth-century Russian newspaper mastheads, engraved letterpress marks and revolutionary poster lettering. Distinct negative spaces and wide strokes, very few fine flourishes: the complete emblem must remain balanced and visually strong as a tiny 20x20 pixel adviser text icon. Luxurious design in the letter shapes, not in extra decorations. No rectangular backing, no circular frame, no book, no flag, no star, no crown, no extra letters. Luminous pale warm GOLD, broad lit faces, shallow amber bevel cuts, subtle painted metal game texture, not deep 3D extrusion or glossy jewelry. Square canvas, icon fills 84 percent with clear transparent margin. Genuine transparent background. Return ONE complete finished icon.

items.label: 社民盟
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign this plain row of three Cyrillic letters into an ELEGANT ARTISTIC INTERLOCKING MONOGRAM for a historical Russian political adviser text icon. Exact abbreviation: С Д С (СДС), no other characters. A prominent tall central Д forms the structural spine; two stylized С letters sweep outward from it on either side in a carefully balanced composition, with interwoven terminals and selected shared horizontal strokes. Make this a single custom-drawn insignia, not three separate typeset letters. Strong old Russian newspaper masthead and engraved letterpress inspiration, flowing yet architectural, distinctive thick curved serifs and beautifully shaped negative spaces. Avoid fragile hairlines and fussy ornament so it still reads as a symbol at only 20x20 pixels. Keep the Cyrillic Д recognizable with its two bottom feet and open counter, and both С open and visible. Gold letters alone create the full emblem; no round/rectangular backing, frame, flag, handshake, pen, star, crown or extra objects. Luminous bright yellow GOLD with broad pale gold faces, shallow amber engraved shadows and subtle painted-metal historical-game finish, not cute, not a glossy 3D logo. SQUARE compact composition occupying 84 percent of width and height, transparent margins. Genuine transparent background. Return ONE complete finished icon.
